description: Turn what this session found into a report you can paste into a document: the posts, comments and listings exactly as the Nooticr tools returned them, as cards with their images, links and figures, between your own analysis. Returns markdown, plus a standalone HTML document as an embedded resource (and in the structured result). Pass sections in order; each is kind posts, comments or products with the items as the tools returned them, or kind analysis with your text. Fetches nothing and sends nothing. No cost to call: no credits are spent. Use when the user asks for a report, a brief or a document built from these results.

items.description: kind posts/comments/products: the items as the tools returned them, unchanged.

note.description: One line under the heading, e.g. where these came from.

text.description: kind analysis: your prose. Other kinds: an optional paragraph above the cards.

summary.description: Your opening read, as plain paragraphs; lines starting "- " become a list.

name: export_report

guidance.description: What to do with this payload, in prose. Read it: it is the instruction, not a summary.

html.description: The report as a standalone HTML document.

reportUri.description: nooticr://report/<id>: the URI of the embedded HTML resource.

title: Export Report
